## BLUF

Shipped and closed. `<leader>t` (triple-click) and `<leader>v` (two-pick span select,
`TextSelectMethod` = ShiftClick | Drag) work fully in Edge and Notepad3. Feishu rejects both
synthesized selection gestures for `v` and alternates on d/t; accepted as an app-specific
limitation with documented workarounds. Full record (5 fix rounds, established facts,
inference hedges): [`20260813-223634_triple-click-and-text-select.plan.qmd`](20260813-223634_triple-click-and-text-select.plan.qmd).

## Commits (all on `master`, CI green at each push)

`3fa79c9` feat: triple-click mode · `9f750df` feat: two-pick text-span selection ·
`b5eab8e` fix: ship t/v in the default LeaderBindings · `6a36a0d` fix: selection actions
close even in Continuous · `24854bf` feat: diagnostic toggles · `137069c` fix: off-thread
input bursts with real gaps (the root-cause fix for flaky d/t) · `c2c7490` fix: XML-comment
MSB3249 · `8f47655` fix: pick-1 always clicks (clears prior selection) · `7bcb37e` docs:
Feishu findings.

## Final verification (build `8f47655`, user-tested on-box 2026-08-14)

| App | d/t | v ShiftClick | v Drag |
|---|---|---|---|
| Edge | works | works | works |
| Notepad3 | works | works | works |
| Feishu | alternates | no selection | selection canceled |

Physical click+Shift+click works in Feishu (user-verified earlier); the gap is specific to
synthesized input there. Mechanism unverified from Linux — hypotheses and how to probe them
are in the plan's `## Inference` section.

## Outcome

Accepted as-is per user decision (2026-08-14). Feishu workarounds recorded in CLAUDE.md:
`<leader>t` every other attempt or after a background click; physical mouse for arbitrary
spans. Current drop: `$HAP_WIN_TEST_DIR/hap-dragfix/hap.exe`.
